platform.description: Social media platform to search. Default is 'combined'.

include_answer.description: Include AI-synthesized answer summary. Default false.

include_raw_content.description: Include full cleaned page content per result by executing advanced extraction. Default false.

include_images.description: Include images related to search results. Default false.

time_range.description: Filter results by time range (day, week, month, or year). Default is no filter.
